and scripts/ingest-poi-region.sh (the transaction). Three literals in three languages is exactly

overtureRelease is the PIN. 2026-07-22.0 is the release the 44-case benchmark in
docs/evidence/places/ was measured on (docs/06 §6.3). Changing it re-measures every number in
that section, so the loader refuses a region whose poi_regions.dataset_release differs from this
Region bboxes are duplicated from the poi_regions rows on purpose and the loader ASSERTS they
are equal before it writes anything: the database is authoritative (10 §2), this file is what
the extract can actually read, and a silent disagreement between the two would load rows
outside the region a query scopes to. tyo and ldn come from 0010's seed; tlv comes from 0020,
which widened it from the Tel Aviv municipality (32.03/32.12, 34.74/34.86) to the MVP launch
area, Tel Aviv PLUS the Hasharon - Herzliya, Ramat HaSharon, Ra'anana, Kfar Saba, Hod HaSharon,
Netanya and Petah Tikva were all outside the old box. Measured on release 2026-07-22.0: the new
box is 79 996 raw rows, 10 462 after the food-and-drink filter below, versus 35 430 / 4 997 for
the old one. If you change a bbox here, change it in a NEW migration too - never in 0010.
_foodAndDrinkComment: docs/06 §7.4: 85.9% of the raw Tel Aviv extract is not food and drink, and this filter is what
keeps the loaded extract at 14-35% of raw size (Tel Aviv: 14.1%). Copied VERBATIM from
docs/evidence/places/measure-extract-size.py, which is where 06 §3.1's storage model was measured
- an 'improved' list here would silently invalidate it.
It is wrong at both margins and that is recorded rather than fixed here (10 §7.1): the substring
patterns admit 377 non-food Tel Aviv rows (%bar% -> barber, %pub% -> public_plaza) and the list
misses real food categories (delicatessen, butcher_shop, lounge, candy_store, sandwich_shop,
chocolatier, gelato). Re-cutting it moves 06 §3.1 and 06 §6.3, so it needs its own ruling.
